procedural_matters: ITA 2's name of the skipper was corrected in the hearing request before the hearing.
ITA 2 was represented by Roman Vyevyenko.
PUR 103 was represented by Ines Mendez-Larminaux.
Javier Figueroa coach of PUR 103 attended the hearing as an observer.
Fiorella Nicolari, Ezio Fonda, Marin Kustic members of the international jury attended the hearing as observers.
facts: The wind and sea conditions were 12 knots with moderate chop.
In race 5, on the leg 1, ITA 2 on starboard-tack and PUR 103 on port-tack were sailing on converging courses.
At a distance of about 1 boat length between ITA 2 and PUR 103, ITA 2 luffed slighty.
At a distance of about half a boat length between, ITA 2 bore away to a close-hauled course.
ITA 2 passed astern of PUR 103 at a distance of 50 cm between PUR 103’s rudder and ITA 2’s starboard bow.
conclusions: PUR 103 on port tack kept clear of ITA 2 on starboard tack and complied with rule 10.
